description: PlatformDriveControl (plan §10.3), the parts that need no disc: openRaw over a disc image file (a drive's raw device is read the same way, in whole 2048-byte sectors): sectorCount is its size / 2048; read(sector, count) gives fewer bytes at the end and none past it; a path that isn't there: fs.notFound {path}. probeContent of something that isn't a drive: unknown. waitForMount of something that isn't a drive: none, at once (within 5 s whatever the timeout). eject and closeTray need a drive with a disc (owner check); on the test VMs' empty virtual drives probeContent is unknown and waitForMount none.
